jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted matte 14th century 2D game sprites matching reference art, warm textured cel shading. Pure flat #FF00FF MAGENTA background in ALL cells, no magenta on subject. No scenery, ground shadows, lettering, numbers, borders or gridlines. Each full figure and all props entirely within its OWN square cell with clean gutters. Right-facing. Consistent anatomy, head size and costume across every pose; never enlarge bent or fallen poses. Final cells 512x512. A peregrine GREY FALCON: blue-grey back and pointed wings, pale cream breast with black spots/barring, dark moustache stripe, yellow feet and cere, dark eye. NOT brown golden eagle. Same distinctive falcon across clips. True articulated bird wings, no duplicate heads or limbs. Flying torso center fixed x256,y300, not feet; complete wing tips visible. World wingspan 345px (0.9 Marko height). EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, row-major equal SQUARE cells. First 8 cells animation. Eight continuous FAST SHARP FLAPS: 1 high wings,2 sweeping wide,3 level,4 downstroke,5 fully down,6 folded upstroke,7 rising open,8 almost high again. Torso stays level. No flask/water.
